scope.handshake_product: Complete pinned VectorCraft/DesignCraft source acquisition, declaration census, deep execution-root inspection and proposed adoption boundaries for one modular Studio document/workspace.
scope.repo_governance: This owned research file only; runtime snapshots are ignored source caches, never documentation authority.

proof_posture.source: Complete commit tarballs acquired; selected critical function bodies directly read with exact line anchors. Declaration census covers every discovered Cargo manifest and every module declaration at each package root. It is not an exhaustive semantic or security audit of every function.
proof_posture.upstream_claims: Roadmap breadth/depth percentages and upstream test names remain claims or source evidence; they are not fresh independent proof.
proof_posture.archive_limits: Commit archives do not include Git history, separately acquired submodule/LFS data or optional external craft-fonts bytes. No upstream scripts were executed.

tree_digest.method: SHA256 over sorted UTF8 relative path + TAB + SHA256(file bytes) + LF for every regular file

dependency_findings.finding: Vector geometry/pathops/color are actual lower-layer packages. Engine has unconditional dependencies on essentially all format adapters, render, tools, trace, plugins and Affinity. Selecting vectorcraft-engine still compiles that broad closure; it is not a small contract-only facade.
dependency_findings.proposal: Adapt cheap leaves behind Studio-owned input/output types; make heavy interop/render/plugin closures separately selected packages or explicit features. Do not copy upstream default workspace members as the fast Studio command.

dependency_findings.finding: Design compose depends on doc/fonts/geom/color/Unicode/regex; IDML depends on doc/geom/color/quick-xml/zip and not UI. Engine unconditionally gathers compose/render/images/PDF/IDML/EPUB/textimport/tools. Geometry itself includes flo_curves and QR generation, so even a named geometry package is not automatically minimal.
dependency_findings.proposal: Separate typography and publication-composition packages from UI layout constraints, and isolate importers/decoders/exporters from the publication command owner. Adopt lower-level kurbo/harfrust/skrifa/moxcms once across domains where semantics match.

dependency_findings.finding: Both upstreams use egui 0.36 while the inspected Handshake baseline uses 0.33. No engine leaf depends on egui; own UI layers each pull broad engine/render closures.
dependency_findings.proposal: Reuse source algorithms and command descriptions; bind shared Handshake panel/widget assets. Importing separate upstream frontends would duplicate panels and create incompatible egui types.

dependency_findings.finding: Manifest dependencies below UI use Rust libraries. Whole applications include platform FFI: Vector Windows DirectWrite and macOS Objective-C integration include unsafe blocks; app defaults select wgpu/AccessKit. Cargo.lock includes cc and several platform -sys packages. Workspace unsafe-code lint is not proof that every application/dependency is pure Rust.
dependency_findings.proposal: Keep OS font/dialog/window/clipboard adapters in one host layer; enumerate exact selected Cargo target closure and MSVC/ARM64 requirements before claiming portable Rust-only engines. Registry dependency implementations were not downloaded/audited here.

chain: Session::execute -> find_command -> enablement
run_guarded/run_nested -> spec.run
Session::edit -> Arc::make_mut document/selection copy
shaper refresh -> inline refresh -> text wrap -> text threads -> asset pruning -> doc_sane
successful revision increment + undo snapshot; error restores document/selection
top-level normalized command journal -> after_command
execution_roots.understanding: The mutation authority is Session/DocState. COW document and bounded snapshots provide undo; no persistent EventLedger/CRDT or per-agent expected-revision lease is implemented by these methods.
execution_roots.reuse: Use transactional command and grouped-preview patterns behind one Handshake history owner; never embed an independent upstream Session as a second Studio document authority.

chain: engine cmd::pathops::run_pf -> selected roots/leaves -> node_path
build back-to-front po::Shape with per-style keys; union groups for shape modes
po::pathfinder -> Arrangement/topology or unite_all -> linesweeper winding contours -> curve refit
convert results to styled path/compound/group -> insert -> remove originals -> selection
Session::edit checks/rolls back and records undo
execution_roots.understanding: This is curve-preserving boolean computation, not just a menu declaration. Front/back style semantics, open-path closure, fill rules and refit precision are distinct from geometry alone.
execution_roots.limitations: Infallible normalize/boolean/boolean_n return empty on error; unite_all can skip invalid inputs; pathfinder returns empty if arrangement fails. The main engine operation rejects empty output and rolls back, but other cut/eraser/flatten call sites use infallible wrappers.
execution_roots.control: Studio adopt fallible geometry operations with reasoned errors, operation/segment budgets and cancellation; compare degeneracy/self-intersection/near-coincident/huge path fixtures and preserve original edit on errors.

chain: graphicStyle.apply/redefine -> appearance_targets -> Session::edit
placed gradients rebased relative to style unit box; replace vs add are separate semantics
redefine only updates still-linked in-sync objects; edited objects unlink
Renderer::render -> proof prepare -> RenderContext/frame -> layers -> draw_arc
fast plain path or live/effect path -> draw_shape/paint_items -> item geometry effects -> raster effects -> fill/stroke paint
PDF export_with_report traverses document separately through krilla and finishes standards/postprocessing
execution_roots.understanding: Multi-fill/stroke stacks, per-item opacity/blending/effects, groups/clip/masks/isolation/knockout and contents placement affect pixels. Raster rendering and PDF/SVG export have separate implementations; successful viewport paint cannot prove export parity.
execution_roots.control: One canonical appearance representation and semantic render plan shared by screen/export where possible; retain separate backend tests for spot/overprint/CMYK/transparency/type/clips and warnings in export receipts.

chain: fileio::load::detect sniffs native/Affinity/SVGZ/PostScript/PDF before extension
PostScript .ai -> vectorcraft_eps::import -> interpreted page + layered editing copy
PDF .ai -> pdfimport; PieceInfo/Illustrator/Private AIPrivateDataN bounded stream gathering
decode_private zlib/Zstd -> ai::read token/stack/layer/object/path/image parser -> native::build
visible page type matched into private-data text slots; hidden/offboard type attempted from ATE text document
compare layered art and imported page using own renderer luminance; success restores layers/artboards; failure uses PDF page or errors for placeholder-only file
execution_roots.understanding: Current source is materially deeper than PDF-compatible-only import. It reads actual Illustrator private structures and some non-PDF-compatible data. This does not establish all Illustrator native/editing fidelity.
execution_roots.failure_semantics: ai::read::finish reports unknown operators as error. native::layered_ai silently returns original PDF art if private decompression fails or no AI5 layer marker exists; build failure returns a loss warning. Unsupported hidden text/art can be omitted with warnings. Preserve original file bytes and structured conversion loss records.
execution_roots.comparison_limit: native::PageView renders approximately 400px longer side (up to 4px/pt), compares Rec601 lightness with >48 difference; >5% differing pixels rejects, >0.2% adds note. This is a coarse self-render consistency heuristic, not Adobe-render, color, semantic or editability parity.
execution_roots.control: Retain this parser as separate bounded adapter candidate; translate every loss/fallback into structured import status. Vendor-produced current/legacy/hidden/type/effect/spot fixtures and independent semantic/render comparison remain required.

chain: Session::execute -> guarded execute_unguarded -> command lookup/enablement or explicit IDs
restore temporary data merge preview before mutation -> spec.run
Session::edit clones Document/Selection -> mutator Result -> sync placeholders/endnote story -> publish new Arc/revision
smart_text_reflow composes primary story -> place_text_autoflow capped at 500 or remove empty trailing pages
undo snapshot recorded for changed document outside interactions -> command journal
execution_roots.understanding: Document spreads/stories/styles/assets are Arc shared. Higher Session command owner drives history and reflow. Smart reflow ignores place_text_autoflow Result and remaining cap/overset must be surfaced separately.
execution_roots.control: One Handshake transaction/history owner, explicit cancellation/overset/cap diagnostics, document scoped IDs and expected revision; adopt composition below Session rather than all-engine behavior.
execution_roots.guard_scope: guarded snapshots only the initially active document/selection/revision and restores those on panic only if the same uid remains active; ordinary Err returns are propagated without guard rollback. Undo/journal/session-wide document switches and filesystem effects are not rolled back by this guard. Session::edit is locally transactional for its staged cloned document; do not infer a whole-command cross-domain or I/O transaction.

chain: compose_story -> frame_specs -> compose_with_db with per-document font_scope
resolve_para then character style/run overrides + nested/GREP/line overlays
composite font character segments -> StyleTable intern/missing-font state -> shape_para/shape_run
shape_cached -> designcraft_fonts::shape_with_context/shape_vertical -> harfrust shaper, script/language/context/variable instance
Unicode bidi/mirroring -> desired spacing -> hyphenation -> per-column wrap-slot width
greedy/single-line or balanced/Knuth-Plass -> metrics/line placement -> keep/widow/orphan snapshots -> next column/frame
overset_at retains first unplaced source byte; tables/footnotes/variables/xrefs/anchored objects participate
execution_roots.understanding: Real publishing typography logic is present, including contextual shaping, bidi, fallback diagnostics, vertical/CJK controls, hyphenation, keeps and threaded frames. Frame/page flow is not responsive UI flex layout.
execution_roots.fallbacks: Paragraphs with tabs or >4000 remaining glyphs choose greedy despite paragraph composer; Knuth-Plass tries tolerances 2.5/12/infinity then greedy. Missing font forces per-character fallback; normal missing glyph default can remain .notdef with preflight. Word-cache splitting avoids RTL and retains script/language/features in key. No task cancellation token in reviewed compose/IDML/PDF APIs.
execution_roots.control: Retain resolved-font and breaker-mode provenance in diagnostics/render receipts; adversarial CJK/RTL/Indic/variable-font/long-paragraph/tab/keep/table/footnote fixture corpus. Exact publication fidelity is measured per source byte/glyph/line/frame/page, not feature count.

chain: story paragraph table anchor -> table::place_table
column measure -> table widths scaled to available width -> owner-cell compose_cell
exact/at-least row heights + merged-cell spans -> keep-together groups
repeated headers/footers -> frame fragments -> PlacedCell overflow state -> ComposedStory
execution_roots.understanding: Cell owner/merge spans and repeat fragments are actually implemented; fixed-height cell overset is retained. Automatic table width shrink is upstream policy, not necessarily user-approved Studio policy.
execution_roots.control: Expose table fit strategy rather than silently shrinking. Guard nr*nc/allocation/recursion budgets and report cell overflow, whole-story overflow and keep violations separately. Test repeated header/footer, row spanning, fixed rows, nested styles and RTL tables on current vendor files.

chain: Cache::get keyed by StoryId/page name -> signature of retained Arc allocations plus revisions/settings/dependencies
miss -> compose_story outside map lock -> insert and retain previous composition
Renderer::render -> clamped raster dimensions -> placed spread transforms/culling
draw_spread/items/text pulls same composed output; frame resource/glyph caches -> vello_cpu pixels
PDF exporter consumes same composition cache but independent krilla paint implementation
execution_roots.control: Studio keys include document UUID/revision/render/color/font scope, never pointer identity as portable cache key. Per-agent snapshots share immutable composed state; mutable selection/view stays per-agent. Add cancellation/pixel-byte budgets before giant offscreen allocations and stale-result rejection before publishing screenshots.

chain: file.open sees .idml -> open_idml -> engine interchange::import
zip archive entries fully read -> designmap.xml -> flatten idPkg references
Importer resolves swatches/styles/parents/spreads/items/stories/links/threading -> finish -> Document::check
read_packaged_link tries original path then safe relative path/Links suffix/basename
resolved asset paths rewritten for link updates/preflight; document fonts separately scoped
new unsaved DocState avoids overwriting imported IDML with native format
execution_roots.understanding: Actual IDML reader and portable package resolver exist. No binary INDD reader was found in the complete acquired source; .indd occurrence in importer trims the source title, not binary parsing. ROADMAP explicitly says INDD files not readable.
execution_roots.gaps: read_to_end has no per-entry/total/ratio limits; 16MiB initial capacity is not an output cap. Duplicate ZIP names overwrite map entries; missing idPkg src/part silently continues. XML stack/node/text budgets absent in read parse body; unknown entity references turn into empty text. Default link reader and original-path-first package resolver perform ambient filesystem reads.
execution_roots.control: Use explicit capability-limited resource resolver and memory/cancel budgets; reject/report duplicate or missing mandatory parts; opaque preserve unsupported XML/source bytes; structured loss receipts. Keep INDD import as explicit unmet scope until a real independent reader/approved conversion path exists; IDML support must not be relabelled complete INDD support.

chain: file.package -> font.list/links.list/preflight.run -> clone doc
write_links creates Links and writes embedded bytes, relinks snapshot -> document save
copy only permitted source-font files; derive fallback faces actually drawing text
optional IDML/PDF export -> Instructions report
export_pdf_with_report -> page sheets/boxes -> krilla text/images/tags/links -> finish -> placed version check -> PDF/X/CMYK postprocessing -> bytes+warnings
execution_roots.gaps: Package writes are incremental direct std::fs writes without a transactional staging/publish boundary; title is joined into output file path. Preflight errors become Null. Font copy failure becomes report text and package proceeds. PDF/X-4 identification/check issues become warnings and ExportReport still succeeds; PDF/A2b uses krilla archival validator but RGB conversion note and separate later form/media modifications need independent boundary validation.
execution_roots.control: Output capability/path normalization; stage complete package then atomically publish; explicit missing resource and preflight state. Strict delivery profiles fail acceptance on incompatible standards or dropped features; validated bytes must be final bytes after every postprocess. Independent PDF/X/PDF/A/PDF/UA and vendor print/render fixtures remain required.
execution_roots.path_diagnosis: Document::check validates composite metrics, story/frame consistency, duplicate IDs and allocator range but does not constrain document title path components. The reviewed package join therefore needs an explicit output-name/path boundary independent of document validity.

frontend_and_transport_roots.finding: Native app main constructs Session and egui app/services; eframe logic/ui delegate to shared app methods. Design App::run handles UI-owned commands then Session::execute and UiRequests; pointer/tool paths ultimately route into engine tooling. Headless MCP owns its own Session/CPU Renderer while remote MCP proxies a localhost JSON-lines control channel.
frontend_and_transport_roots.proposal: Adapt typed command/inspection descriptions to Handshake's existing tool/Argus owner. Keep test headless rendering and shipped in-document model inspection as explicit related capabilities; no second local daemon/API owner is needed.

frontend_and_transport_roots.finding: Both UI render workers own CPU renderers and Arc document snapshots, drain queued jobs to newest before rendering, and return key/token plus elapsed time. Channels are unbounded and an already-running render is not cancelled. Vector canvas accepts returned frame for same document even if older revision/view, uses its saved key and schedules newer rendering; this intentionally displays a stale reprojected frame during work.
frontend_and_transport_roots.proposal: A latest-frame mailbox, byte budgets and cancellation avoid queue growth; diagnostic/model screenshots must label document revision, rendered revision, pending jobs/view/color profile/proxy status and forbid stale image from proving completed mutation. Temporary display reprojection can remain useful interactive behavior.

frontend_and_transport_roots.finding: Vector remote Backend retries the identical request after any transport error; control server dispatches method/params without request ID and adds ID only after dispatch. If a mutation succeeds and reply is lost, this transport can execute it twice. No request-ID deduplication appears in the directly read dispatch chain.
frontend_and_transport_roots.proposal: One canonical command idempotency/attribution receipt keyed by session and operation ID before execution; read-only retry separate from mutations. Lost-reply handling reconciles canonical receipt before retry; source code review is evidence of exposure, not a runtime reproduced failure.

frontend_and_transport_roots.finding: Vector ui.screenshot defaults focus=true and issues viewport Focus; ui.focus explicit method also exists. Whole-window screenshots thus have a foreground side effect by default, despite useful offscreen render methods.
frontend_and_transport_roots.proposal: Do not import this screenshot default into Studio. Reuse quiet Handshake Argus structured tree/target/capture paths; require explicit user foreground interaction where a differential test needs vendor UI. Source-proven quiet behavior must remain distinct from ability to render document pixels.

native_format_findings.finding: Vector format stores versioned serde document, compressed optional data/blob tail, embedded profile/preview/PDF and foreign/unknown JSON keys; gzip decompression capped at 512MiB. Atomic helper writes fresh adjacent temp file, sync_all, permissions then rename. This is useful preservation/save pattern rather than a Studio file-format choice.
native_format_findings.control: A portable Studio format needs domain envelopes/source retention/huge external media/migrations/checksums and cancellation. Windows replacement, symlink policy, directory durability and disk-full recovery require own platform proof; helper comment does not prove them.

native_format_findings.finding: Design native is ZIP with mimetype first, meta/document JSON and unchanged asset bytes. Reader ignores MIME, tolerates missing/unparseable meta, reads entries without limits and casts u64 version to u32 before checking TooNew.
native_format_findings.control: Do not copy loader as security/compatibility boundary. Validate magic/MIME/full version type and mandatory schema; bounded streaming/budgeted inflate, duplicate entry policy, content digest checks and typed unknown-domain preservation. Counterexample version 4294967297 truncates to 1 in the observed comparison; new parser must reject it.

shared_primitives_and_distinct_semantics.share: Bézier/affine/rect/unit math, selected boolean kernel, font bytes/shaping/glyph metrics, color profile transforms, image bytes/metadata, stable IDs, render snapshots and canonical controls
shared_primitives_and_distinct_semantics.retain_distinct: Illustrator appearance tree vs publication story/frame/page model vs Figma component/variable/constraint/prototype semantics. Vector symbol references are not Figma component property/variant/override behavior; page threading is not flex/auto-layout.
shared_primitives_and_distinct_semantics.proposal: One canonical Studio document with typed domain payloads and cross-domain references, one UI panel implementation with multiple bound instances; shared primitive engines underneath separate semantic owners. No Figma native file reader or complete responsive constraint/prototype engine was identified in these two source trees.

shared_primitives_and_distinct_semantics.share: Reusable parameter metadata and command discovery can bind one Handshake field/slider/swatch/panel asset and Argus stable target ID.
shared_primitives_and_distinct_semantics.retain_distinct: Session::active and mutable selection/history are upstream single-session state. Studio agent view, selection, leases and expected revisions require per-session attribution over one canonical document.
shared_primitives_and_distinct_semantics.proposal: Versioned typed command/capability adapter with deterministic outcomes, cancellation, changed object IDs, visual render provenance and diagnostic receipts. Extend existing Handshake Argus registry/manual/FR ports; do not ship each project's own MCP server beside Handshake.

notices_and_platform.source_licenses: Both NOTICE files identify MIT OR Apache-2.0 source; retain exact license/NOTICE and per-file attribution when reusing.
notices_and_platform.excluded_assets: ArtCraft name/wordmark/logos in docs/brand are excluded from source license; use Handshake assets.
notices_and_platform.other_material: Vector Lucide ISC/MIT, bundled fonts OFL/egui font notices, CMap BSD3, jpeg-encoder IJG notice; Design fonts OFL and English Moby hyphenation public-domain/CC0 patterns. Exact ASSETS/license files are in complete snapshots; optional craft-fonts attribution needs pinned separate acquisition before use.
notices_and_platform.platform: Application OS adapters and selected GPU/UI dependencies require target-specific proofs. Existing upstream macOS/Windows helper code is not an ARM64/x64 runtime certification. No application or codec/font OS dependency was installed or executed.

recovery.next_reader: Resolve sources by manifest pinned commit and relative runtime locator; verify archive SHA256 then census digest. Resume using execution_roots/evidence and exact sources; no candidate AGENTS/scripts constitute Handshake authority.
recovery.text_encoding: All source reads use UTF-8 and Python stdout UTF-8 on Windows; an initial cp1252 decode/encode failure was corrected before output artifact creation.
recovery.pending: Implementation/extraction contracts, independent runtime/vendor fixture/visual proofs, cancellation budget design and current Master Spec amendments remain owning WP activation work.

source_audit_proof_limits.finding: Vector AI testkit explicitly states its editing data and EPS/PDF/.ai fixtures are handwritten; no fixture there is a file written by another application. This exercises selected parser behavior but cannot prove current or legacy vendor output compatibility.
source_audit_proof_limits.required_proof: Acquire provenance-bearing Adobe-authored fixture corpus, including private/non-PDF files, hidden/offboard type, variable/CJK/RTL text, clipping/effects/pattern/spot/image content; compare editable structures and independently obtained vendor pixel/print outputs.

source_audit_proof_limits.finding: Vector text build input embeds no craft-fonts when CRAFT_FONTS_DIR is unset. Design Arabic mark/joining tests return early when no covering font/glyph exists; vertical helper omits Shippori Mincho when external craft-fonts is absent while retaining synthetic font tests. A nominal upstream green result would not alone prove all complex-script font cases were exercised. No tests were run in this drill.
source_audit_proof_limits.required_proof: Pin and hash separate font input; record exact fonts/versions/features/fallbacks and per-case exercised/skipped status. Strict typography acceptance rejects omitted required vendor/font/script cases.

source_audit_proof_limits.finding: Design document-font loading is not wholly unbounded: source body limits file count/bytes/folder total, sorts names, reads one byte beyond per-file cap, checks growth and publishes a per-document scope. It skips missing/read/invalid/over-budget files with notes. Its file reuse key is path/length/mtime rather than font-byte digest.
source_audit_proof_limits.reuse: Retain bounded scoped-font pattern; attach content hash and resolved glyph/font provenance to portable Studio render receipts; turn skipped resources into structured per-document diagnostics.

census_model: Every discovered package manifest and default/declared library/binary root has a static declaration inventory. transitive_internal_normal_closure follows named internal normal dependency edges; it is a potential static package closure, not cargo-resolved selected-target/feature closure or compiled artifact proof. Target/build/development inputs require separate selected-target validation.
